summary: Loads a bitmap file into the rendering composition system, gated by the audio-initialized global at 0x8B8E28. Validates the filename, resolves a resource-table entry through this+0x128 and this+0x124, allocates raw-data buffers, reads and optionally post-processes the bitmap data, hands it to RenderingCompositionSetup, then frees the buffers. Logs an error and returns a negative status on any failure.

If the initialization flag at dword_8B8E28 is set, proceed with the bitmap load path.
Resolve the resource-table entry: take the table pointer at this+0x128, index it by this+0x124 shifted left 8, and read the two size fields at entry+8 and entry+12.
Allocate two raw-data buffers with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper using the two sizes read from the resource entry.

Read the bitmap data from the file handle at this+0x10 using ThreadSafeReadWrapper_803f; when the flag bit 0x10 of the resource entry is set, read into the second buffer and post-process it with sub_59B260, otherwise read into the first buffer, failing if the byte count does not match.
Hand the loaded buffer to RenderingCompositionSetup(dword_8B78A0, v10, v13, a2, 1, 0) to register the bitmap in the composition system.
On any read or setup failure: free both buffers via FreeWrapper_7bcf, format the "Error loading bit map %s" message using the entry filename, log it through sub_53C590(-1, v15) and return -1.
Success path: free both allocated buffers with FreeWrapper_7bcf and return 0.
